Software Engineer 1 - Full Stack
We are looking for a motivated Software Engineer with 1-3 years of experience developing, testing, and maintaining reliable, scalable, high-performance fullstack applications and APIs.
Strong programming fundamentals and hands-on experience with Java, Kotlin, or Python, ReactJS are required.
Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, test, and maintain backend applications, services, and RESTful APIs using Java, Kotlin, or Python, ReactJS and frameworks such as Spring Boot, Django, or FastAPI.
- Write clean, efficient, reusable, maintainable code and collaborate with engineers and Product Managers.
- Develop unit and integration tests. Apply object-oriented programming, design patterns, and Test-Driven Development (TDD).
- Work with relational databases, write efficient SQL queries, and understand transactions, ACID properties, and data consistency.
- Debug production issues, participate in code reviews, and improve performance, monitoring, and reliability of backend services.
- Work in an Agile team and take ownership of tasks with testing and documentation.
- Learn microservices, distributed systems, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and root cause analysis.
- Use agentic development tools to deliver features.
Qualifications:
- Strong Java, Kotlin, or Python programming skills and ReactJS experience.
- Experience with Spring Boot, Django, or FastAPI and developing and consuming RESTful APIs.
- Familiarity with Git, version control workflows, and CI/CD fundamentals.
- Strong analytical and communication skills and willingness to learn.
